modifiers.name: Fevered Cinders
modifiers.counterplay: Burning remains useful; the haste is announced by a visible step pulse.

modifiers.name: Borrowed Relief
modifiers.counterplay: Move out of the announced echo ring after healing; echoes cannot trigger further echoes.

modifiers.name: Scars of the Mighty
modifiers.counterplay: Kill elites near arena edges and leave a safe approach to each exit.

modifiers.name: Unequal Shelter
modifiers.counterplay: Inspect the displayed extremes and use positioning against the newly exposed family.

modifiers.name: Divine Surges
modifiers.counterplay: An announced surge window strengthens fragments without suppressing the baseline build.

modifiers.name: Accumulated Memory
modifiers.counterplay: Three prior rooms nominate traits in order; the boss keeps at most two distinct compatible traits. Inspect skipped candidates before commitment.

hunts.name: The False Vael
counterplay: Stand in inactive vents; each cycle retains a melee approach.
Interrupt one rebuilding limb while the other visibly charges.
Carry cooling gaps between marked solar waves.

hunts.name: Ilyra Reborn in Teeth
counterplay: Read the root trail before each jaw surfaces.
Close one brood channel to preserve a safe flank.
Break seed guards during the announced feeding pause.

hunts.name: The Thousand Memories of Serath
counterplay: Use procession gaps; the real body always carries a solid sigil.
Interrupt only the marked repeating echo to avoid replenishing it.
Cross the silent lane after each visible bell pulse.

hunts.name: Orrun Without an Oath
counterplay: Move along numbered faults as stone settles behind each strike.
Deposit marked terms on separate safe plinths.
Exploit the recovery after the final oathless slam.

hunts.name: The Shape That Remembers Nhal
counterplay: Anchor glyphs distinguish real safe space from decorative absence.
Interrupt a marked copy channel while preserving another exit.
Follow the stable rhythm beneath the reversed sound cues.
